title: Tour of Alcazar and Giralda
text: We toured the Alcazar and Giralda with Ricardo through ‘Not Just a Tourist’. His explanation of the history was fascinating, and it was so interesting to hear how we were standing in the city and buildings where the history of the Americas started from. He was insightful and very intelligent, and interesting. He was not dry and boring but brought history to life. Thank you for a great tour, Ricardo!
author: lucymY9164WW

title: Terrific overview of the city tour!
text: It was our first time using Not Just a Tourist and it was fantastic!  I found them with a search and messaged about what we wanted.  They were prompt to respond and answered all of our questions. We used this company for 3 services and they were all fantastic.  On our first day in Seville we met Guille for a 2 hour Walking Tour.  It was an excellent way to see an overview of the city and get oriented.  Guille showed us all of the highlights. title: Walking tour of Seville
text: Oscar was well informed very interesting spoke well and clearly, explained the history of Seville very well and was a very easy and pleasant guide
author: kevino441

title: Great private tour, thanks to Luna
text: Luna was absolutely fantastic! Her deep knowledge and passion truly brought the tour to life. She shared both the historical and mythological sides of Seville’s story, making the experience not only informative but also engaging and memorable. Luna also made sure to point out great spots for photos, which was much appreciated. Even though we spent extra time at Plaza de España, ending the tour 20 minutes late, she never rushed us and allowed us to fully enjoy the moment. Her dedication and enthusiasm made the tour unforgettable!
author: xiaofanw784
